en.title: The Rockefellers: Standard Oil, industrial concentration, antitrust, dynastic capital and the institutions of philanthropy
en.deck: A study of the Rockefeller family from the oil-refining system to the Standard Oil breakup, public health philanthropy, finance and divergent contemporary heirs.
keywords: The Rockefellers: Standard Oil, industrial concentration, antitrust, dynastic capital and the institutions of philanthropy
en.regime: Historical industrial and institutional transformation constrained by law, capital and social structure.
en.key_risk: Confusing individual fortunes, firm balance sheets, social externalities and institutional power.
watch: Evidence of welfare versus private returns
en.search_text: The Rockefellers: Standard Oil, industrial concentration, antitrust, dynastic capital and the institutions of philanthropy

producer_checks.information_cutoff: 24 October 2026; historical national archives, primary records and economic history; financial histories not current market prices.
producer_checks.editorial_novelty: Dedicated institutional rockefeller dossier, separate from existing Marginal Thinking archive.
producer_checks.visual_signature: Substantive analytical comparison table, traceable historical chart, causal flow and geographical/institutional representation in each language.
producer_checks.source_check: 8 matched source URLs across both languages; archival, official and specialist institutional references.
producer_checks.bilingual_parity: Chapter count and numeric chart series aligned; same source URLs.
producer_checks.methodology: Separates capital stocks, historical flows, productive spillovers, legal structure, and limits of causal inference.
